by, and should be read in conjunction with, the more detailed information and financial statements included elsewhere in this prospectus.

sections.title: Dividend Policy
sections.excerpt:
DIVIDEND POLICY We have not previously declared, or paid cash
dividends and we have no plan to declare or pay any dividends in the near future on our shares. We currently intend to retain most, if
not all, of our available funds and any future earnings to operate and expand our business. We are a holding company incorporated in the Cayman
Islands with limited liability. We rely principally on dividends and other distributions from our Operating Subsidiaries in Hong Kong
for our cash requirements, including any payment of dividends to our shareholders. Applicable regulations may limit the ability of our
